_help: Config for the 'Share Photos & Videos' button inside the Ministry Outreach & Highlights call-out on news.html. Paste your Google Drive folder URL into 'uploadUrl' so team members can upload directly from the site. Admins: when setting up the folder for the first time, create a new Google Drive folder, right-click it → Share, set 'General access' to 'Anyone with the link' with 'Editor' permission so teammates can upload without a Google login barrier, then copy the share URL into uploadUrl below. The button stays hidden on the site until a real URL is configured. See admin-help.html for the full walkthrough.
